prototypeNotice: Illustrative prototype records only — not live taxpayer data. Proposed SLA values and unresolved role/policy assumptions remain subject to formal approval.

overview.title: Audit Overview
overview.description: All-Circle audit oversight for risk distribution, queue health, reconciliation and review workload. Risk Level is a review priority, not a finding.

riskCases.title: Risk Cases
riskCases.description: Prioritized cases created from substantive A–E risk signals across the officer's global Audit scope.
riskCases.note: Risk Level is a review priority, not a conclusion. Findings require a verified signal linked to evidence. TIN is masked by default.

control.title: Control & Data Quality
control.description: Separate F0–F5 consistency and filing-control queue. These items do not increase substantive Risk Level.
control.note: Data-quality and control flags stay on a separate path from Risk Cases. F5 dependency remains unresolved in the source framework.

secondReview.title: Second Review
secondReview.description: Supervisory review of completed verification trails before closure.
secondReview.note: The current design brief assigns second review to the supervising Range Officer. Review must name the signal and evidence; generic approval text is not sufficient. Permitted outcomes are Sign off or Request rework.

rules.title: Rules & Governance
rules.description: Versioned rule change requests, mandatory dry-runs, endorsement, approval and controlled rollout.
rules.note: Rules are never edited in place. New or changed rules require a dry-run, then follow DCT authoring → Range Officer endorsement → Commissioner approval under the current design assumption. Shadow mode records results without routing cases.

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
reconciliation.description: Daily confirmation that each high-risk return has a corresponding case within the relevant supervisory scope.
reconciliation.note: Reconciliation is surfaced to Range Officers for their Circles and to the Commissioner for the Zone. A mismatch is an oversight issue; it does not silently change Risk Level.

trail.title: Audit Trail
trail.description: Append-only event history for assessment, human decisions and sensitive-data access.
trail.note: Nothing is overwritten or deleted. Corrections are new events. Return Version, Classification Version and Rule/Config Version travel with the assessment so the original decision can be reconstructed.

allTaxpayers.title: All Taxpayers
allTaxpayers.description: Global audit population across all Circles. Search any taxpayer or return, then use Circle and audit dimensions to narrow the population.
allTaxpayers.note: This Audit workspace is configured for cross-Circle access. Circle remains an operational context and filter, not an access boundary.

overview.signalLinkedEvidence: Evidence stays linked to a specific signal
overview.proposedSlaNote: Based on proposed, not approved, SLA defaults
overview.riskPrinciple: Screening → Verification → Audit → Final Determination are separate activities. A signal or Risk Level does not automatically become a Finding, assessment, demand or accusation.
overview.globalAccessDescription: This officer can inspect taxpayers across all Circles. Circle is retained for filtering, grouping and operational context.

initiate.title: Initiate Audit
initiate.description: Build this year's audit candidate population step by step using Circle scope, data readiness and the screening rules defined in the Audit framework.

setup.title: Audit setup
setup.desc: Choose the assessment year and how this selection exercise will be built.

population.title: Select population
population.desc: Audit all Circles or combine any set of Circles. Circle is an operational filter, not an access limit for this officer.

readiness.title: Data readiness & coverage
readiness.desc: Checked values stay eligible. Uncheck a Data Quality state or Coverage Tier to remove matching returns from the next step.

criteria.title: Select audit criteria
criteria.desc: Apply the relevant risk, control or manual-selection logic. The system keeps Control Flags separate from substantive Risk Signals.

preview.title: Candidate preview
preview.desc: Inspect the matched taxpayers before confirmation. Audit concepts remain clickable for rule explanations.

review.title: Review & confirm
review.desc: Review the complete selection basis before adding taxpayers to this year's Audit Candidates register.

riskCriteria.title: Risk criteria
riskCriteria.desc: Choose the risk conditions a return must satisfy. The matched count below updates immediately as you change these selections.

controlCriteria.title: Control criteria
controlCriteria.desc: Select one or more F0–F5 filing, arithmetic or consistency controls. These controls remain separate from substantive Risk Level.

manualSelection.title: Select taxpayers
manualSelection.desc: Search the readiness-eligible population and select individual returns directly. No legal selection reason code is added unless it is defined by an approved source.

fields.searchTaxpayer: Search TIN, Return ID, taxpayer or Circle

population.title: Population / Circle-based Audit
population.desc: Circle scope + data readiness only. No Risk Level, signal or control criterion is added.

risk.title: Risk-based Audit
risk.desc: Use Risk Level and/or A–E signals, with Any/All matching when multiple signals are selected.

control.title: Control / Data Quality Review
control.desc: Use F0–F5 control flags only. Control selection remains separate from substantive Risk Level.

manual.title: Manual Selection
manual.desc: Search the eligible population and select individual returns directly. Undefined legal reason codes are not invented.

all.title: All Circles
all.desc: Use the complete population available to this officer.

selected.title: Selected Circles
selected.desc: Combine any number of Circles into one audit-selection population.

populationCriteria.title: No additional screening rule required
populationCriteria.desc: For a Population / Circle-based Audit, every taxpayer that survives the selected Data Quality and Coverage filters moves to Candidate Preview. This track is a product selection workflow, not a Risk Signal from the supplied framework.

controlCriteria.note: F0–F5 are handled on the separate Control / Data Quality track and do not automatically increase substantive Risk Level.

match.help: This only matters when more than one signal is selected.
match.anyDesc: Include a return when at least one selected signal is present.
match.allDesc: Include a return only when every selected signal is present.

adjustments.title: Candidate adjustments
adjustments.desc: Keep or exclude individual matches before confirmation. Excluding a matched taxpayer requires a reason so the original selection result is not silently rewritten.
adjustments.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why this matched taxpayer is excluded from this selection batch.

review.candidateCount: taxpayers will be added to the Audit Candidates register.
review.confirmDesc: Confirming creates candidate records only. It does not automatically create Findings or final tax determinations, and newly confirmed candidates start as Selected / Not Started.

validation.completeStep: Complete the required selections in this step before continuing.

readiness.dataQualityHelp: Checked states are included. Uncheck a state to exclude returns with that Data Quality.
readiness.coverageHelp: Checked tiers are included. Uncheck a tier to exclude returns in that Coverage Tier.

impact.title: Selection impact
impact.description: These counts update automatically from your choices. They do not create audit findings or determinations.
impact.populationHelp: Returns in the selected assessment year and Circle scope.
impact.eligibleHelp: Returns still included after Data Quality and Coverage filters.
impact.excludedHelp: Returns removed by the current readiness selections.
impact.matchedHelp: Eligible returns that match the current track criteria.
impact.finalHelp: Candidates that will move forward after your preview adjustments.

riskSignals.help: Select the screening signals a return should match. Search by signal code or description.
riskSignals.noResults: No Risk Signals match this search.

candidates.title: Audit Candidates
candidates.description: This assessment year's audit-candidate register, including selected taxpayers not yet started and cases already moving through the audit workflow.
candidates.yearDesc: Selected means the taxpayer is planned for audit but an active audit case has not necessarily started. Once work begins, Audit Status follows the case workflow.
